about: A development set for tuning the redact task's NER pass, kept apart from ner-sample.json, whose figures are the ones published. Invented like the sample; some sentences hold no entity at all, so that false positives show, and the acronyms and the common words that are also names (bill, rose, Will) are there for the same reason.
